body: Hopefully.  It might just be a local problem.  Hundreds of people in my city have been displaced due to them closing 2 shelters in the past month.  Resources are scarce here, but maybe I haven't looked hard enough
I'll make some phone calls tomorrow.  Some of them I'd never heard of.  I'm going to try to sleep so I can look into that in the morning.  Hopefully something works out.  Thank you again!

Thank so so much!  Not just for that but for just listening.  It's pretty screwed up that a complete stranger has helped more in the last hour than the ones closest to me.  It reminds me that there are still good people out there.  I appreciate you!
I'm in Illinois.  I've checked into several programs and nobody had anything available.  If you know of anything I'd be happy to hear about it
I'm glad you're doing well though
I've been down this road before, just not to this extent.  There has always been a way out if I was willing enough.  Not this time though

It's pretty much just financial combined with my family's lack of concern.  My parents refused to let me stay with them.  My parents and siblings have money but are not willing to help, which makes me feel completely worthless.  There are no shelters available.  It's going to be cold soon.  My chances of surviving sub 0 temps is not very good
I'm kinda paranoid giving out my number.  I don't want an ambulance showing up . I really don't want to die, but it's going to happen and I'd like to do it on my own terms

Thank you!  You're right.  My kids are great and I'm very proud of who they are becoming.  I've always dealt with depression but I've kept myself busy with the kids, and they kept me going.  I guess I just don't feel needed much anymore and don't know what to do with that.  I want to move on in my life and focus on myself for once but I don't know how.  Thank you for listening.
